sources.title: XTTS-v2 — TTS Model
sources.snippet: XTTS-v2: Multilingual voice cloning with only 6 seconds of audio. Learn about its focus, availability, and use cases.

sources.title: XTTS v2 (Coqui TTS): Free Local Voice Cloning, 17 Languages
sources.snippet: XTTS v2 (Coqui TTS) is the free, open-source ElevenLabs alternative you run locally — clone any voice from a ~6-sec sample in 17 languages. 2026 setup, specs & benchmarks. Install in one command: pip install coqui-tts.
